scenes.author: Javier Blánquez (ed.)
scenes.desc: Bandas indies que tienden puentes entre el rock y la música de club a raíz de la nostalgia por la disco y el post-punk; unió para siempre a los públicos del indie y del baile.

podcast.title: Canadian Two-Piece Band
podcast.body: Death from Above 1979 is cited as one of the Canadian two-piece rock bands that gained prominence in the early 2000s, contributing to the rise of this musical format. "A lot of this new generation were Canadian. Black pistol fire, death from above 1979."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 100 Greatest Rock Moments of the Millennium So Far - Part 6: (50-41)

podcast.title: Early Canadian Tour
podcast.body: Death from Above toured across Canada alongside Alexis on Fire and Billy Talent, an experience that allowed these bands to gauge the national appetite for aggressive music. "We went across Canada with death from above."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Alexisonfire - In Their Own Words Podcast

xref.title: Canadian Two-Piece Band
xref.body: Black Pistol Fire is mentioned as part of a new generation of two-piece rock bands, notably among several Canadian acts that flourished in the 21st century. "A lot of this new generation were Canadian. Black pistol fire, death from above 1979."

xref.title: Canadian Two-Piece Band
xref.body: Japandroids is listed as a Canadian two-piece band that emerged in the early 2000s, contributing to the growing phenomenon of rock duos. "A lot of this new generation were Canadian. Black pistol fire, death from above 1979. Japan droids, the PAKAD, USS Duortang, the Blue Stones."
